strategy.name: exhaustion_reversion
strategy.description: Fades climactic runs: four same-direction bars covering 2.5 ATR with a volume spike, entered against the run with a stop beyond its extreme. Experimental; not traded live.

criteria.name: Out-of-sample expectancy after costs is positive
Walk-forward expectancy after costs is positive
At least 60% of walk-forward windows positive
Still profitable at 1.5x costs on every symbol
Beats the 95th percentile of random entries with the same geometry

validation.note: A strategy is not called successful because of a high historical win rate. It must survive out-of-sample and walk-forward testing after realistic costs, keep an edge at higher costs, and beat random entries with the same risk geometry.

reliability.note: Historical simulation: outages, missed events and recovery times are measured in paper/live session reports (signal-bot-research session-report).
